title: SDR DEVELOPPER
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for: 

  • Design and develop Software-Defined Radios solutions,
  • Understanding the SDR strategy, and provide ideas,
  • Implement and maintain rendering pipelines with strict performance and latency constraints,
  • Collaborate with electronics designers,
  • Collaborate with designers, product teams, and systems engineers
  • Participate in architectural decisions and long-term modem technical strategy
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation and review code at a senior level

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong background in SDR mathematics (linear algebra, transforms, projections)
  • Solid experience developing Software-Defined Radio
  • Practical experience with SDR and PCB
  • Experience working under real-time constraints (frame budgets, latency, motion-to-photon)
  • Programming languages : C / Rust / ASM

You

  • 3 to 10 years of professional experience in software development, with a significant focus on SDR
  • Proven track record working on technically complex and critical systems
  • Strong SDR reasoning and ability to understand large, existing codebases
  • High level of rigor, autonomy, and attention to detail, Strong interest in solving non-trivial technical problems
  • Nice-to-Have Skills : Electronics design
  • Nice-To-Have Skills : Contributions to open-source

Interview Process

  1. 15-Min Screening Call : Quick chat about motivation, fit and answer your non tech questions.
  2. 2x1-Hour Technical/Product Interview : Deeper dive into your problem-solving approach with our CTO and/or our lead solution architect
  3. Team Meet & Greet : Informal session to ensure good culture fit.

What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge XR and spatial computing technologies
  • Ownership over technically challenging, real-time systems
  • Highly technical and intellectually challenging projects
  • An environment that values genuine engineering expertise and that is tech focused (no nonsense meetings or reportings)
  • Strong autonomy in technical decision-making
